note: No Level 2 metrics. Every quantity this task records is a moral preference (sparing more people, the young, humans over pets, the lawful; intervening), and Level 2 scores accuracy on a scale where exceeding the human mean is better. A preference has no better direction, so scoring it there rewarded an agent for being more extreme than people and counted each preference twice, once here and once as its Level 3 signature. Whether an agent shares the human preference is tested at Level 3. The source-study rates remain in scoring/human_baselines/moral_machine.json for reference.
